limitations: Timeline nodes contain emitted claims; visual sequences and action hypotheses are separate evidence records.
Visual token features preserve frame PTS but are not semantic action labels.
Visual action hypotheses are unverified and are not passed to Qwen narration.
Cosine similarity is not probability or human verification.
Start-time ordering and interval overlap do not imply causality.
The model output is an unverified candidate, not a human-verified event.
The top-two margin and candidate-set softmax are not calibrated confidence.
Overlapping windows may keep ranking an action after its visible onset or offset.
RGB pixel deltas are raw frame differences, not optical flow or action evidence.
The output is an external diagnostic baseline and is not integrated into the default analyze route.
The candidate is retained in EventGraph but is not sent to Qwen narration.
